tool_action.public_message: I’ll just take Pennsylvania Railroad at list. Not trying to start a railroad arms race—just fine locking in a steady little income piece and moving on.
tool_action.private_thought: Buy it. Railroads are efficient early cashflow, and more importantly it prevents an auction where someone else could snag it under 200. Diversifies beyond Light Blues, gives leverage for future trades (especially if others collect 2-3 railroads). Publicly I downplay rail ambitions to avoid opponents contesting the other railroads aggressively or pricing them up in auctions.
